9.3.1.1 Defined interfaces
The interfaces of
Communication Management
are categorized into interfaces for
SecOC
(see Section 9.3.1.1.2), and interfaces freshness value management (see Sec-
tion 9.3.1.1.3). Please note that a implementation of
Communication Management
will generate additional interfaces for each modeled Service Interface, e.g. a
Proxy
and a
Skeleton
interface. However, these generated interfaces are currently not cov-
ered in this document.
